title: Serve the page from a local stdlib HTTP server
chosen: A small server in dashboard.py, started by the coordinator, that serves the page and takes answers.
drawback: Needs a running process; the page closes when the coordinator stops it.

alternatives.option: Publish the page as a hosted artifact
alternatives.why: answers would need a copy-paste step back to the agent (F3)

alternatives.option: Rewrite a static HTML file the browser reloads

title: Read agent state from structured logs
chosen: Each agent writes logs/<agent>.json with role, task, mode and branch; the page reads fields.
drawback: Every agent must write the file; a missing file shows the agent without a task.

alternatives.why: fragile; matching text breaks when wording changes

title: Deliver your answers to the coordinator by long-poll
chosen: The coordinator runs `wait`, which returns as soon as you send something; it restarts it each time.
drawback: If the coordinator forgets to restart `wait`, answers sit unread; the page shows a warning (Q2).

alternatives.why: needs code outside the standard library or a hand-written protocol (C1)

alternatives.option: The coordinator polls the log file
alternatives.why: adds delay up to the poll interval (Q1)
